label: Health and Wellness Team
blurb: A Wellness Coach with fitness, nutrition, sleep and health admin
purpose: For building healthier habits that stick. The Wellness Coach agrees the goals; the team plans workouts, meals, sleep and habits, and keeps health paperwork organised. It is not medical advice.

project.name: Health
project.goal: Build a few healthy habits that last, one step at a time.

members.title: Wellness Coach
members.name: Leilani
focus: Agree one or two goals and check in every week.

members.title: Fitness Coach
members.name: Marco
focus: Plan the week's workouts to fit the time available.

members.title: Nutrition Planner
members.name: Anjali
focus: Plan balanced meals and a shopping list.

members.title: Habits and Sleep Coach

focus: Help build one small habit at a time and better sleep.

members.title: Health Admin Assistant
